tables.title: Deposits in, and Withdrawals from the Bank of Chosun, South Korean Interim Government, October 1945-January 1948
footnotes: a/ Revenue from the Department of Transportation is not included.

Separate note at foot of page, also marked a/: The Bank of Chosun is the national depository of the South Korean Interim Government. The government deposits its revenue with the bank and draws on it for all government expenses. The Overdraft Account and the Revenue Deposit Account are kept separately by the bank and the government pays 3 per cent interest on excess overdrafts over the revenue deposits.
